items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We going to have to – I’m going to let Tom Lord know. He’s got you listed in the orchestra...

ctx.x: I was in on only – you know what? I wasn’t in on the rhythm. Freddie recorded with a rhythm section, and then when I came in to do my solos, it was overdubbed. So he wasn’t there. Later on we did some other projects together, but on First Light, all that stuff was sweetened. Don Sebesky brought me in. Creed had me play here and play there. That’s how that thing happened.

We going to have to – I’m going to let Tom Lord know. He’s got you listed in the orchestra for Let My Children Hear Music for Mingus, New York, September 23rd, 1971, but your recollection is that you didn’t play with Mingus. But . . .
No, no, I just don’t remember him . . .
